# Why did my Etsy bulk upload fail?

> Free Etsy bulk listing CSV checker: finds titles over 140 characters, more than 13 tags, tags over 20 characters, bad prices and currency codes, quantities over 999, broken image links, duplicate variation choices and Excel-damaged SKUs, with line numbers, and applies safe fixes.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
